interpretation: Diagnostic same-state intervention matrix over 64 complete states, 16 source episodes, and 16 tasks. Evidentiary strength additionally depends on preregistration and held-out confirmation.

oft_rpc_inference.measurement_scope: OFT action-prediction RPC transfer plus server inference; excludes environment stepping and client rollout control.

success_then_env_steps.semantics: On states where at least one arm succeeds, lexicographically maximize terminal success, then minimize env_steps.
